selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: At what time of day does the passage say this person especially needs to turn to Allah?
questions.answer: At Fajr, in the early morning.

questions.question: What two acts are mentioned for turning to Allah at that time?
questions.answer: Prayer and making dua.

questions.question: How is Allah described in this passage?
questions.answer: As perfectly powerful, full of glory, full of compassion, and full of beauty.

questions.question: What should a person ask Allah for in the early morning?
questions.answer: For success and for help.

questions.question: Why is that early morning turning to Allah called a source of support?
questions.answer: Because it helps a person face the events of the coming day.

questions.question: What relationship between a servant and Allah is shown in this passage?
questions.answer: The servant is needy and asks, while Allah is powerful, merciful, and able to give.

questions.question: What does presenting a petition to Allah mean here?
questions.answer: It means asking Him sincerely for what one needs.

questions.question: Why is early morning a fitting time for this request?
questions.answer: Because it comes before the day’s events and responsibilities arrive.

questions.question: Which is more suitable at Fajr according to the passage: depending only on yourself or asking Allah for help?
questions.answer: Asking Allah for help.

questions.question: How does the passage connect worship with daily life?
questions.answer: It shows that worship gives strength for dealing with everyday challenges and duties.

questions.question: What overall message about morning worship is given here?
questions.answer: Morning worship prepares the soul for the whole day by connecting it to Allah.

questions.question: What practical benefit of Fajr prayer is highlighted here?
questions.answer: It gives inner strength to deal with the day.

questions.question: What does the passage say is essential for the human spirit in the early morning?
questions.answer: Turning to Allah through prayer and dua.

questions.question: What title in the passage shows Allah has complete power over all things?
questions.answer: The description of Him as the All-Powerful One.

questions.question: What title in the passage shows Allah’s mercy toward His servants?
questions.answer: The description of Him as All-Compassionate.

questions.question: What are the two main difficulties of the coming day mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: The things that will happen and the duties that will have to be carried.

questions.question: How does the passage show the value of dua?
questions.answer: It presents dua as a real means of receiving help and strength from Allah.

questions.question: Is the tone of the passage more about pride in oneself or dependence on Allah?
questions.answer: It is about dependence on Allah.

questions.question: What action is the soul urged to take at that time?
questions.answer: To go to Allah with prayer and supplication.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention Allah’s glory along with His compassion?
questions.answer: To show that the One being asked is both mighty enough to help and merciful enough to care.

questions.question: According to the passage, when should a person prepare spiritually for the day?
questions.answer: At the start of the day, during Fajr.

questions.question: What kind of support is being discussed here: physical, spiritual, or both?
questions.answer: Mainly spiritual support, which helps a person handle daily life.

questions.question: What future part of the day is this morning worship meant to prepare a person for?
questions.answer: The events and responsibilities that will come later that day.

questions.question: What main lesson does the passage teach about Fajr?
questions.answer: Fajr is a necessary time to seek Allah’s help before the day begins.
